alt.sw: Wasimamizi wa ofisi wakipanga mahudhurio ya wafanyakazi

title.en: Before buying an attendance machine, ask these three questions.
title.sw: Kabla ya kununua mashine ya mahudhurio, jiulize haya.

summary.en: A short guide for offices, hotels and growing businesses in Tanzania: start with your shifts and reports, then choose the equipment.
summary.sw: Mwongozo mfupi kwa ofisi, hoteli na biashara zinazokua Tanzania: anza na zamu na ripoti unazohitaji, kisha chagua vifaa.

title.en: 1. What do you need to know each day?
title.sw: 1. Unahitaji kujua nini kila siku?

text.en: For an office, it may be arrivals and late attendance. A hotel may need overnight shifts, days off and approved overtime. Write down your actual working patterns before comparing machines. A fingerprint or face terminal records events; it does not decide your employment policies.
text.sw: Ofisi inaweza kuhitaji taarifa za waliofika na waliochelewa. Hoteli inaweza kuhitaji zamu za usiku, mapumziko na muda wa ziada ulioidhinishwa. Andika ratiba zako halisi kabla ya kulinganisha mashine. Mashine hurekodi matukio; haiamui sera za kazi.

title.en: 2. One site, or several branches?
title.sw: 2. Eneo moja au matawi kadhaa?

text.en: Confirm how records will reach the person preparing reports. USB collection, a local network and a managed online system have different practical requirements. If internet or power is interrupted, ask how the selected terminal stores records and synchronizes later. Do not assume every model supports Wi-Fi or every software edition.
text.sw: Hakiki namna rekodi zitakavyomfikia anayetoa ripoti. USB, mtandao wa ndani na mfumo wa mtandaoni vina mahitaji tofauti. Umeme au intaneti ikikatika, uliza kifaa kinahifadhi vipi rekodi na kuzituma baadaye. Si kila modeli ina Wi-Fi au inaoana na kila toleo la programu.

title.en: 3. Who checks and approves the report?
title.sw: 3. Nani anakagua na kuidhinisha ripoti?

text.en: Ask for a demonstration using your shift pattern, including missed punches and overnight work. Agree who may see staff records, correct exceptions and export reports. Keep access limited and explain the system to staff. Attendance data needs review before it is used for payroll; payroll integration is a separate scope.
text.sw: Omba maonyesho kwa ratiba yako, pamoja na rekodi zilizokosekana na zamu za usiku. Kubaliana nani anaona taarifa, anasahihisha makosa na kutoa ripoti. Dhibiti ruhusa na waeleze wafanyakazi matumizi ya mfumo. Ripoti zikaguliwe kabla ya mishahara; muunganisho wa payroll ni kazi tofauti.

cta.en: Tell BM your staff count, locations and shifts. We can scope the terminal, software, installation and training in one quotation.
cta.sw: Tuambie idadi ya wafanyakazi, maeneo na zamu. BM inaweza kuainisha mashine, programu, ufungaji na mafunzo kwenye nukuu moja.

alt.sw: Mlango na mazingira ya ofisi ya kisasa

title.en: A secure office door needs more than a fingerprint reader.
title.sw: Usalama wa mlango wa ofisi ni zaidi ya reader ya fingerprint.

summary.en: Reader, lock, controller and exit arrangements: a simple checklist for planning office access control in Moshi, Arusha and beyond.
summary.sw: Reader, kufuli, controller na njia ya kutoka: mambo ya kuangalia unapopanga access control ya ofisi Moshi, Arusha na maeneo mengine.

title.en: Start with the door and the people.
title.sw: Anza na mlango na watumiaji.

text.en: A glass reception door, a timber office door and an outdoor staff entrance may need different locks and fixings. Decide who should enter, at what times, and how visitors are received. A site assessment should inspect the door condition and cable route before selecting equipment.
text.sw: Mlango wa kioo wa mapokezi, wa mbao wa ofisi na mlango wa nje wa wafanyakazi vinaweza kuhitaji makufuli na vifaa tofauti. Amua nani aingie, muda gani na wageni wapokelewe vipi. Tathmini iangalie hali ya mlango na njia za nyaya kabla ya kuchagua vifaa.

title.en: Plan a complete system.
title.sw: Panga mfumo kamili.

text.en: The reader identifies a credential; a compatible controller applies access rules; the lock secures the door. Include the power supply, exit button, door sensor and suitable backup where required. An IP-rated outdoor reader still needs properly sealed cable entries. Confirm the exact card technology and firmware before reusing existing readers.
text.sw: Reader hutambua kadi au alama; controller inayooana hutekeleza ruhusa; kufuli hufunga mlango. Jumuisha power supply, kitufe cha kutoka, sensor ya mlango na umeme wa akiba inapohitajika. Reader ya nje yenye IP rating bado inahitaji nyaya zilizofungwa vizuri. Hakiki aina ya kadi na firmware kabla ya kutumia tena vifaa vya zamani.

title.en: Test exit and power-loss behaviour.
title.sw: Jaribu kutoka na umeme unapokatika.

text.en: Emergency exit and power-loss behaviour must be assessed for the specific door and building. Ask for a practical handover: approved entry, denied entry, normal exit and the agreed emergency procedure. Avoid choosing a lock only by its appearance or advertised holding force.
text.sw: Njia ya dharura na namna mfumo unavyofanya kazi umeme ukikatika vitathminiwe kwa mlango na jengo husika. Wakati wa makabidhiano, jaribu ruhusa ya kuingia, kukataliwa, kutoka kawaida na utaratibu wa dharura uliokubaliwa. Usichague kufuli kwa mwonekano au nguvu iliyotangazwa pekee.

cta.en: Send BM the door type, number of entrances and required access hours. Request a site survey for a complete installed-system quotation.
cta.sw: Tuma aina ya milango, idadi ya sehemu za kuingia na saa za ruhusa. Omba tathmini ya eneo kwa nukuu ya mfumo kamili.

alt.sw: Detector ya chuma ya mkononi ya ZKTeco ZK-D180

title.en: Metal detector, inspection mirror or X-ray: which job needs which tool?
title.sw: Detector ya chuma, kioo au X-ray: kila kifaa kina kazi gani?

summary.en: A clear starting point for hotels, institutions and controlled entrances. These tools do different jobs and need a planned inspection procedure.
summary.sw: Mwongozo kwa hoteli, taasisi na malango yenye ukaguzi. Vifaa hivi vina kazi tofauti na vinahitaji utaratibu wa matumizi.

title.en: People: handheld metal detection.
title.sw: Watu: detector ya chuma ya mkononi.

text.en: A model such as ZK-D180 helps trained staff check for metal objects using visual and selectable sound or vibration alerts. It does not detect every prohibited item. Agree a respectful inspection procedure and demonstrate settings with suitable test objects before use.
text.sw: ZK-D180 husaidia walinzi waliofunzwa kukagua vitu vya chuma kwa viashiria vya mwanga na sauti au mtetemo. Haigundui kila kitu kilichokatazwa. Panga ukaguzi wenye heshima na fanya maonyesho ya settings kwa vitu vya majaribio vinavyofaa.

title.en: Vehicles: a visual check underneath.
title.sw: Magari: ukaguzi wa macho wa sehemu ya chini.

text.en: A wheeled mirror such as ZK-M3 lets an operator see parts of the vehicle underside. Light, positioning and a safe inspection area matter. It is a manual visual aid, not automatic detection or proof that a vehicle is safe.
text.sw: Kioo chenye magurudumu kama ZK-M3 humwezesha mlinzi kuona sehemu ya chini ya gari. Mwanga, mpangilio na eneo salama la ukaguzi ni muhimu. Ni msaada wa macho, si mfumo wa kugundua vitu moja kwa moja wala uthibitisho wa usalama wa gari.

title.en: Baggage: specialist X-ray screening.
title.sw: Mizigo: ukaguzi maalumu wa X-ray.

text.en: ZKX6040 is a baggage X-ray reference with a 600 × 400mm tunnel. It is a different class of system from a handheld detector. Space, power, trained operators, radiation-safety requirements and applicable local approvals need specialist review before procurement. Confirm the full scope and support arrangement rather than ordering by model name alone.
text.sw: ZKX6040 ni rejea ya X-ray ya mizigo yenye tundu la 600 × 400mm. Ni mfumo tofauti na detector ya mkononi. Nafasi, umeme, mafunzo, usalama wa mionzi na vibali vinavyohitajika vinahitaji tathmini ya mtaalamu kabla ya ununuzi. Hakiki kazi nzima na msaada badala ya kuagiza kwa jina pekee.

cta.en: Tell BM what you need to inspect, the entrance layout and expected traffic. We will confirm equipment availability and the assessment needed.
cta.sw: Tuambie unachotaka kukagua, mpangilio wa lango na wingi wa watumiaji. Tutahakiki upatikanaji wa vifaa na tathmini inayohitajika.

alt.en: Architectural view of a modern lodge entrance at dusk
alt.sw: Mwonekano wa lango la lodge ya kisasa wakati wa machweo

title.en: Planning security for a new building? Start with the doors.
title.sw: Unapanga ulinzi wa jengo jipya? Anza na milango.

summary.en: Three decisions to make before buying cameras, intercoms or access control for your property.
summary.sw: Maamuzi matatu kabla ya kununua kamera, intercom au vifaa vya kudhibiti milango ya jengo lako.

title.en: 1. Draw the routes people use
title.sw: 1. Chora njia wanazotumia watu

text.en: A hotel has different routes for guests, staff and deliveries. Mark each entrance, who should open it and what happens after hours. Set aside private areas when planning camera views.
text.sw: Hoteli ina njia tofauti kwa wageni, wafanyakazi na wanaoleta mizigo. Weka alama kwenye kila mlango, bainisha nani anaruhusiwa kufungua na utaratibu wa baada ya saa za kazi. Epuka kuelekeza kamera kwenye sehemu za faragha.

title.en: 2. Check power and cable routes
title.sw: 2. Kagua umeme na njia za nyaya

text.en: If the building is still under construction, agree conduits and equipment positions before the finishes go in. On an existing site, test the cable before choosing a two-wire intercom and check how each critical device stays powered during an outage.
text.sw: Ikiwa ujenzi unaendelea, kubaliana kuhusu mabomba ya nyaya na nafasi za vifaa kabla ya kazi za umaliziaji. Kwa jengo lililopo, pima nyaya kabla ya kuchagua intercom ya nyaya mbili, na hakiki namna kila kifaa muhimu kitakavyopata umeme wakati umeme wa kawaida umekatika.

title.en: 3. Decide what the operator must do
title.sw: 3. Bainisha kazi za mhudumu wa ulinzi

text.en: A receptionist may need to answer the door. A security desk may need to review footage after an alarm. Write down the actual workflow, then verify the devices, firmware and licences needed to support it.
text.sw: Mhudumu wa mapokezi anaweza kuhitaji kuzungumza na mgeni mlangoni. Wahudumu wa ulinzi wanaweza kuhitaji kukagua video baada ya tahadhari. Andika hatua wanazopaswa kufuata, kisha hakiki vifaa, firmware na leseni zinazohitajika.

cta.en: Send BM your floor plan and the entrances you need to manage. Ask for equipment only or a site assessment and installed quotation.
cta.sw: Tuma kwa BM mchoro wa jengo na milango unayotaka kudhibiti. Omba vifaa pekee au tathmini ya eneo pamoja na nukuu ya ufungaji.

alt.sw: Amplifaya ya PA ya AHUJA SSA-250M

title.en: Planning a PA system? Start with the room, not the wattage.
title.sw: Unapanga mfumo wa sauti? Anza na eneo, si idadi ya W.

summary.en: A short guide for Tanzanian schools, hotels, offices and places of worship choosing paging and sound equipment.
summary.sw: Mwongozo mfupi kwa shule, hoteli, ofisi na maeneo ya ibada Tanzania yanayochagua vifaa vya matangazo na sauti.

title.en: 1. What needs to be heard, and where?
title.sw: 1. Ni sauti gani, na isikike wapi?

text.en: A classroom announcement, a meeting microphone and background music in hotel corridors have different needs. Note the room sizes, ceiling heights, nearby noise and whether announcements must reach separate areas. Good coverage is about where sound goes and how clearly people hear it.
text.sw: Tangazo la darasani, kipaza sauti cha mkutanoni na muziki wa koridoni hotelini vina mahitaji tofauti. Andika vipimo vya vyumba, urefu wa dari, kelele na maeneo yanayohitaji matangazo tofauti. Mpango mzuri unalenga sauti ifike inapohitajika na ieleweke.

title.en: 2. Match the amplifier and speakers.
title.sw: 2. Oanisha amplifaya na spika.

text.en: Confirm the exact outputs, speaker versions and selected power taps before choosing cable runs or quantities. For example, the SCM-15 and SCM-15T look similar but are specified for different connections. A 100 V installation and a low-impedance system require different planning. Ask BM to check existing equipment before adding speakers.
text.sw: Hakiki matokeo ya amplifaya, toleo la spika na chaguo za W kabla ya kuamua nyaya au idadi. Kwa mfano, SCM-15 na SCM-15T zinafanana lakini zina mahitaji tofauti ya kuunganisha. Mfumo wa 100 V na wa impedansi ndogo hupangwa tofauti. Omba BM ihakiki vifaa vilivyopo kabla ya kuongeza spika.

title.en: 3. Separate equipment supply from installation.
title.sw: 3. Tofautisha vifaa na kazi ya ufungaji.

text.en: For equipment-only supply, send models, quantities and the intended application. For a complete installation, ask for mounting, cabling, zone setup, sound checks and user handover to be identified in the quotation. Include the site location and existing system details so the assessment has a useful starting point.
text.sw: Kwa vifaa pekee, tuma modeli, idadi na matumizi. Kwa ufungaji kamili, nukuu itaje vifaa vya kufungia, nyaya, usanidi wa maeneo, majaribio ya sauti na makabidhiano ya matumizi. Taja eneo na mfumo uliopo ili tathmini ianze na taarifa muhimu.

cta.en: Tell BM about your building, paging areas and existing equipment. Request current equipment prices or a planned site assessment.
cta.sw: Ieleze BM aina ya jengo, maeneo ya matangazo na vifaa vilivyopo. Omba bei za sasa au tathmini ya eneo iliyopangwa.

alt.en: Technical planning beside closed electrical switchboards
alt.sw: Mipango ya kiufundi karibu na paneli zilizofungwa

title.en: Planning an electrical project? Start with a useful brief.
title.sw: Unapanga mradi wa umeme? Anza na taarifa zinazoeleweka.

summary.en: A short guide for Tanzanian facilities managers, commercial property owners and procurement teams preparing an electrical assessment or BOQ enquiry.
summary.sw: Mwongozo mfupi kwa wasimamizi wa majengo, wenye biashara na timu za ununuzi Tanzania wanaoandaa tathmini au ombi la BOQ la umeme.

title.en: 1. Describe what the facility needs.
title.sw: 1. Eleza mahitaji ya eneo.

text.en: Name the location, building or process, existing supply and equipment to be served. Include motor nameplates or a load schedule if available. A list of equipment ratings is a starting point, not a complete demand calculation or cable design.
text.sw: Taja eneo, aina ya jengo au shughuli, umeme uliopo na vifaa vinavyohitaji umeme. Jumuisha taarifa za nameplate za mota au orodha ya mizigo ikiwa ipo. Uwezo wa kila kifaa ni taarifa ya kuanzia, si hesabu kamili ya demand au usanifu wa kebo.

title.en: 2. Make the BOQ and drawings usable.
title.sw: 2. Weka BOQ na michoro katika hali inayotumika.

text.en: Identify drawing revisions, quantities, required specifications and whether you want supply, installation, assessment or maintenance. Ask BM how to share documents securely; the website enquiry form does not upload attachments. Mark uncertain existing conditions for a site visit.
text.sw: Taja matoleo ya michoro, idadi, vipimo na kama unahitaji vifaa, ufungaji, tathmini au matengenezo. Omba BM ikuongoze kutuma nyaraka kwa usalama; fomu ya tovuti haipokei viambatisho. Weka wazi hali ya eneo inayohitaji ziara.

title.en: 3. Plan access and responsibilities.
title.sw: 3. Panga ufikiaji na majukumu.

text.en: Explain essential loads, shutdown windows and the target timeframe. Specialist control, utility and lift interfaces require clear appointments and applicable authorizations. Ask what tests, handover documents and maintenance support will be included before comparing quotation totals.
text.sw: Eleza mizigo muhimu, muda wa kuzima mfumo na ratiba unayolenga. Miingiliano maalumu ya udhibiti, utility na lifti inahitaji watu walioteuliwa na idhini zinazohusika. Uliza vipimo, nyaraka za makabidhiano na huduma zitakazojumuishwa kabla ya kulinganisha jumla za nukuu.

cta.en: Share your facility type, site location and intended scope with BM. Start a technical assessment or BOQ discussion through our Moshi and Arusha offices.
cta.sw: Ieleze BM aina ya eneo, mahali na wigo unaokusudia. Anza mazungumzo ya tathmini ya kiufundi au BOQ kupitia ofisi zetu za Moshi na Arusha.

alt.en: Generator system assessment beside closed equipment
alt.sw: Tathmini ya mfumo wa jenereta karibu na vifaa vilivyofungwa

title.en: Before you ask for a generator price, prepare these three things.
title.sw: Kabla ya kuomba bei ya jenereta, andaa taarifa hizi tatu.

summary.en: A practical quotation checklist for Tanzanian offices, hotels, institutions and facilities with an existing generator.
summary.sw: Mwongozo wa kuomba nukuu kwa ofisi, hoteli, taasisi na maeneo yenye jenereta Tanzania.

title.en: 1. List what must run together.
title.sw: 1. Orodhesha vifaa vinavyotumika pamoja.

text.en: Include pumps, motors, refrigeration, lifts where relevant, lighting and IT loads. Note the phase and which circuits are essential. Starting demand and operating sequence can change the required size; a bill or a larger kVA label alone does not settle the design. Sensitive no-break loads may need UPS support.
text.sw: Jumuisha pampu, mota, vifaa vya baridi, lifti inapohusika, taa na vifaa vya IT. Taja awamu na saketi muhimu. Mzigo wa kuanzisha na mpangilio wa matumizi vinaathiri ukubwa unaofaa; bili au kVA kubwa pekee haviainishi mfumo. Vifaa visivyovumilia kukatika vinaweza kuhitaji UPS.

title.en: 2. Explain the site and the duty.
title.sw: 2. Eleza eneo na namna ya matumizi.

text.en: Share the location, available space, access, likely running hours, noise considerations and existing transfer panel. Ask for foundations, exhaust, ventilation, fuel arrangements, cables, protection and commissioning to be clearly included or excluded. Standby and prime ratings describe different duties.
text.sw: Taja eneo, nafasi, ufikivu, saa za matumizi, kelele na paneli ya kubadili umeme iliyopo. Msingi, moshi, hewa, mafuta, kebo, kinga na majaribio ya mwisho viwekwe wazi kwenye nukuu. Standby na prime ni viwango vya matumizi tofauti.

title.en: 3. Bring the identifiers and maintenance history.
title.sw: 3. Andaa namba za vifaa na historia ya huduma.

text.en: For an existing set, provide its make/model, engine serial number, controller reference, hours and fault symptoms. For a part, add the existing part number and quantity. Send documents or photographs through an agreed channel; the website form does not upload files. Ask what testing, handover records and maintenance support the quotation includes.
text.sw: Kwa jenereta iliyopo, toa chapa/modeli, namba ya injini, kidhibiti, saa za kazi na dalili za hitilafu. Kwa kipuri, ongeza namba ya kipuri na idadi. Tuma nyaraka au picha kwa njia mtakayokubaliana; fomu ya tovuti haipokei mafaili. Uliza vipimo, nyaraka za makabidhiano na huduma zilizo kwenye nukuu.

cta.en: Tell BM whether you need equipment, a complete installation or maintenance. Share your site and essential loads to start a useful technical quotation.
cta.sw: Iambie BM kama unahitaji vifaa, ufungaji kamili au matengenezo. Taja eneo na vifaa muhimu kuanza nukuu yenye taarifa za kiufundi.

alt.en: Solar arrays on a commercial campus
alt.sw: Paneli za sola kwenye majengo ya biashara

title.en: Before a solar quotation, prepare your energy brief.
title.sw: Kabla ya nukuu ya sola, andaa taarifa za matumizi.

summary.en: Three practical steps for Tanzanian businesses, institutions, lodges and farms planning solar, storage or a hybrid system.
summary.sw: Hatua tatu za kuandaa sola, betri au mfumo mseto kwa biashara, taasisi, lodges na mashamba Tanzania.

title.en: 1. Know the work and the hours.
title.sw: 1. Bainisha shughuli na saa za matumizi.

text.en: List essential appliances, running hours, motor starting and what runs together. Bring electricity bills or measured demand where available. kW is power; kWh is energy. A battery nameplate does not tell you how many hours the entire building will run.
text.sw: Orodhesha vifaa muhimu, saa za matumizi, kuanzisha mota na vifaa vinavyotumika pamoja. Andaa bili au vipimo vya matumizi ikiwa vipo. kW ni uwezo wa umeme; kWh ni kiasi cha nishati. Lebo ya betri haionyeshi jengo lote litapata umeme kwa saa ngapi.

title.en: 2. Bring the site and equipment details.
title.sw: 2. Andaa taarifa za eneo na vifaa.

text.en: Identify the roof or land, shade, access and existing generator, inverter and battery model labels. For pumping, add source yield, daily water volume, total head and tank requirements. A compatible system is selected together; adding panels or mixing batteries without assessment is not the starting point.
text.sw: Bainisha paa au ardhi, vivuli, ufikivu na lebo za jenereta, inverter na betri zilizopo. Kwa pampu, ongeza uwezo wa chanzo, ujazo wa maji kwa siku, total head na mahitaji ya tanki. Vifaa vinachaguliwa kama mfumo; kuongeza paneli au kuchanganya betri bila tathmini si mwanzo unaofaa.

title.en: 3. Ask for a complete, clear scope.
title.sw: 3. Omba wigo kamili ulio wazi.

text.en: Distinguish equipment supply from installation, protection, approvals, monitoring and maintenance. Grid export needs an applicable approved arrangement; do not assume cash payments. Ask about commissioning, handover records, account ownership and support terms. Send documents through an agreed channel; the enquiry form does not upload files.
text.sw: Tofautisha ugavi wa vifaa na ufungaji, kinga, idhini, monitoring na matengenezo. Kurudisha umeme gridi kunahitaji mpangilio ulioidhinishwa; usidhani malipo ya fedha. Uliza majaribio ya mwisho, nyaraka, umiliki wa akaunti na masharti ya huduma. Tuma nyaraka kwa njia mtakayokubaliana; fomu haipokei mafaili.

cta.en: Tell BM your site, essential loads and whether you need equipment, a complete system or maintenance. Start with an energy assessment and a quotation built around your requirements.
cta.sw: Ieleze BM eneo, vifaa muhimu na kama unahitaji vifaa pekee, mfumo kamili au matengenezo. Anza na tathmini ya nishati na nukuu kulingana na mahitaji yako.
